title_zh: 决定先索取咖啡店加盟费用明细

scenario.label_zh: 决定先索取咖啡店加盟费用明细
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对虚构加盟方案的顾虑，并决定在了解费用前不签署文件

context_zh: 虚构商业沟通练习：两位角色讨论一家编造的咖啡店加盟提案，不构成投资或法律建议。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: Are you ready to sign for the coffee franchise?

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Frankly, no. The brochure shows the entry fee but says little about the ongoing costs.

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: The representative wants an answer today.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: I am inclined to wait. I want a written breakdown of the monthly charges before I decide.

sentences.speaker: Rafael
sentences.text: Then I will tell her you are not signing today and ask for that breakdown.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Yes, please. Asking for details is not an agreement to join.
